competencies.name: Communicating
competencies.description: Students develop their ability to communicate clearly, creatively, and confidently in a variety of modes and media.

competencies.name: Thinking, problem-solving & creating
competencies.description: Students engage in higher-order thinking, problem-solving, and creative design across disciplines.

competencies.name: Managing information & thinking
competencies.description: Students locate, evaluate, synthesise, and communicate information from a range of sources.

competencies.name: Working with others
competencies.description: Students collaborate effectively, recognise the contributions of others, and resolve disagreements constructively.

competencies.name: Personal effectiveness
competencies.description: Students develop self-awareness, resilience, and the capacity to make informed choices about their learning and lives.
